title: Accommodation Near NUST Islamabad: Complete Guide for Visitors
excerpt: Where to stay when visiting NUST Islamabad — best areas (E-11, G-11, G-10), accommodation types, pricing, transport, and booking tips for admissions, exams, and visiting faculty.
author: Kor Da Team
body:
Visiting NUST (National University of Sciences & Technology) Islamabad for admissions, exams, convocation, or as visiting faculty? This guide covers the best accommodation options near NUST's H-12 and Sector E-11 campuses — from walking-distance studios to family apartments.

## NUST Islamabad Campuses

| Campus | Sector | Main Gate | Key Departments |
|--------|--------|-----------|-----------------|
| **Main Campus (H-12)** | H-12 | H-12 Main Gate | Engineering, CS, Business, Architecture |
| **Sector E-11 Campus** | E-11 | E-11 Gate | Some engineering, research centers |
| **Risalpur Campus** | Risalpur (KPK) | — | Aviation, Aerospace (not covered here) |

*This guide focuses on H-12 and E-11 campuses in Islamabad.*

## Best Areas for NUST Visitors (Ranked by Distance)

| Area | To H-12 Campus | To E-11 Campus | Best For | Price (PKR/night) |
|------|----------------|----------------|----------|-------------------|
| **E-11** | 8-10 min drive | **Walking distance** | Closest to E-11, budget studios, students | 3,500–5,500 |
| **G-11** | 10-12 min drive | 5-7 min drive | Family apartments, Metro, value, parking | 5,500–8,000 |
| **G-10** | 12-15 min drive | 8-10 min drive | Modern apartments, markets, Metro access | 5,000–8,500 |
| **H-12 / H-13** | **Walking distance** | 10-12 min drive | Closest to main campus, newer builds | 6,000–12,000 |
| **F-11** | 15-18 min drive | 12-15 min drive | Margalla views, premium, quiet | 5,000–10,000 |
| **I-10 / I-9** | 10-12 min drive | 15 min drive | Budget, industrial area, transport hub | 3,500–6,000 |

## Accommodation Types for NUST Visitors

### 1. E-11 Studios & 1-Beds — Best for Solo Parents/Students
- **Distance:** Walking to E-11 campus, 8-10 min drive to H-12
- **Format:** Compact studio or 1-bed with kitchenette
- **Price:** PKR 3,500–5,500/night
- **Guests:** 1-2
- **Best for:** Student visiting for exam/admission, solo parent dropping child
- **Amenities:** WiFi, AC, kitchenette, study desk, parking (some)

### 2. G-11 2-Bed Apartments — Best for Families
- **Distance:** 5-7 min drive to E-11, 10-12 min to H-12
- **Format:** Full 2-bed apartment with kitchen, living, parking
- **Price:** PKR 5,500–8,000/night
- **Guests:** 3-5
- **Best for:** Family staying during admissions week, convocation
- **Amenities:** Full kitchen, WiFi, AC, parking, washing machine, Metro access

### 3. G-10 Modern Apartments — Balanced Option
- **Distance:** 8-10 min drive to E-11, 12-15 min to H-12
- **Format:** Modern 1-2 bed apartments
- **Price:** PKR 5,000–8,500/night
- **Guests:** 2-4
- **Best for:** Visiting faculty, researchers, longer stays
- **Amenities:** Full kitchen, WiFi, AC, parking, building security, Metro

### 4. H-12/H-13 Premium — Closest to Main Campus
- **Distance:** Walking to H-12 main gate
- **Format:** Newer 1-2 bed apartments, some serviced
- **Price:** PKR 6,000–12,000/night
- **Guests:** 2-4
- **Best for:** Visiting faculty, conferences, premium preference
- **Amenities:** Gym, pool (some), high-speed WiFi, parking, modern finishes

## Booking by Visit Purpose

### Admissions Season (July–September, January–February)
- **Book 4-6 weeks early** — highest demand
- **E-11 & G-11 fill first** — closest & most affordable
- **Stay length:** 3-7 days typical
- **Budget tip:** E-11 studios best value for solo parents

### Exams (Mid-semester, Finals)
- **Book 2-3 weeks early**

- **Need:** Quiet, reliable WiFi, study desk

### Convocation / Graduation
- **Book 4-8 weeks early** — families book early
- **Stay length:** 2-4 days

### Visiting Faculty / Researchers
- **Monthly stays** — negotiate 20-30% discount
- **Need:** Workspace, high-speed WiFi, printing access

title: Family Accommodation in Islamabad: A Practical Guide
excerpt: Finding family-friendly accommodation in Islamabad — best areas, what to look for, pricing, nearby schools/hospitals/parks, and tips for stress-free family stays.
author: Kor Da Team
body:
Traveling to Islamabad with family? Whether you're visiting relatives, on a medical trip, government posting, or vacation — finding the right family accommodation makes all the difference. This practical guide covers everything parents and family travelers need to know.

## Why Families Choose Short-Term Rentals Over Hotels

| Factor | Hotel | Short-Term Rental (Kor Da) |
|--------|-------|---------------------------|
| Space | 1 room | 2-3 bedrooms + living + kitchen |
| Meals | Restaurant/room service | Cook at home — save 40-60% |
| Privacy | Shared corridors | Entire property to your family |
| Laundry | Expensive service | In-unit washing machine |
| Kids' space | None | Bedrooms, living room, balcony |
| Cost (family of 4) | 2-3 rooms @ PKR 15k+/night | 2-bed apt @ PKR 7k-10k/night |

## Top Family-Friendly Areas in Islamabad

### 1. G-11 — Best Overall Value
- **Why:** Metro station, G-11 Markaz (markets, banks), parks, wide roads, parking
- **Property types:** 2-3 bed apartments, some houses
- **Price:** PKR 5,500–8,000/night
- **Nearby:** Metro Bus, Fatima Jinnah Park (10 min), schools, hospitals

### 2. DHA Islamabad — Premium Secure
- **Why:** Gated, 24/7 security, internal parks, playgrounds, community centers, schools
- **Property types:** Villas, townhouses, premium apartments
- **Price:** PKR 7,000–20,000/night
- **Nearby:** DHA schools, DHA hospital, DHA park, Monal (15 min)

### 3. Bahria Town — Community Feel
- **Why:** Master-planned, parks in every phase, Safari Park, cinema, malls, schools, hospitals inside
- **Property types:** Villas, apartments, townhouses
- **Price:** PKR 6,000–18,000/night
- **Nearby:** Bahria schools/hospitals, Safari Park, Centaurus Mall (20 min)

### 4. G-13 — Budget-Friendly Government Area
- **Why:** Quiet, government employee housing, affordable, Metro planned, near parks
- **Property types:** 2-3 bed apartments
- **Price:** PKR 4,500–6,500/night
- **Nearby:** G-13 Markaz, Fatima Jinnah Park, multiple schools

### 5. F-11 — Modern & Scenic
- **Why:** Newer construction, Margalla Hills views, good connectivity, modern amenities
- **Property types:** Modern 2-3 bed apartments
- **Price:** PKR 5,000–9,000/night
- **Nearby:** F-11 Markaz, Margalla Trail 5, Centaurus (15 min)

## Family Accommodation Checklist

### Must-Haves (Non-Negotiable)
- [ ] 2+ bedrooms with proper beds (not sofa beds for kids)
- [ ] Full kitchen: stove, fridge, microwave, cookware, utensils
- [ ] High-speed WiFi (for kids' entertainment, work, school)
- [ ] AC in **all** bedrooms + living room
- [ ] Washing machine (essential with kids)
- [ ] Geyser/hot water for baths
- [ ] UPS or generator backup
- [ ] Parking (if you have a car)
- [ ] CNIC-verified host (mandatory on Kor Da)

### Nice-to-Haves
- [ ] Balcony/terrace for kids to get fresh air
- [ ] Iron/steamer for uniforms/clothes
- [ ] Study desk for homework/remote work
- [ ] Building security guard
- [ ] Nearby park/playground (walking distance)
- [ ] Elevator (if upper floor with stroller)
- [ ] Bathtub (easier for toddlers)

## Nearby Essentials by Area

| Area | Hospital | Park/Playground | School | Market |
|------|----------|-----------------|--------|--------|
| G-11 | PIMS (15 min) | G-11 Park | Multiple | G-11 Markaz |
| DHA | DHA Hospital | DHA Parks | DHA Schools | DHA Mall |
| Bahria | Bahria Hospital | Safari Park, Phase parks | Bahria Schools | Bahria Mall |
| G-13 | PIMS (15 min) | Fatima Jinnah Park | Multiple | G-13 Markaz |
| F-11 | Aga Khan (15 min) | Margalla Trail | Multiple | F-11 Markaz |

## Pricing for Families (PKR/night)

- **2-bed apartment:** 6,500–8,500 (Islamabad), 5,500–7,500 (Rawalpindi DHA/Bahria)
- **3-bed house/villa:** 10,000–25,000
- **Guest house (multi-room):** 5,000–12,000
- **Monthly (28+ nights):** 20–30% discount

**Pro tip:** Rawalpindi (DHA, Bahria Town) offers 15-25% better value for similar space, with 15-20 min Metro/Expressway access to Islamabad.

## Booking Tips for Families

1. **Book early** — family units go fast during Eid, summer, school admissions
2. **Message host** about: crib availability, high chair, kid-friendly utensils, nearest pharmacy
3. **Confirm parking** — essential if driving from another city
4. **Ask about noise** — upper floors quieter, avoid main road-facing units
5. **Monthly stays** — negotiate directly via WhatsApp for 1-3 month government postings

## Medical Travel with Family?

If visiting PIMS, Shaukat Khanum, or Aga Khan:
- **G-8/G-9** — walking distance to PIMS
- **G-10/G-11** — near Shaukat Khanum & Aga Khan
- Filter "Near Hospital" category on [Kor Da Explore](https://www.kordaa.com/explore/)

title: Furnished Apartments in Islamabad: What to Know Before Renting
excerpt: Complete guide to renting furnished apartments in Islamabad — what's included, pricing, areas, verification, and checklist for a smooth stay.
author: Kor Da Team
body:
Renting a furnished apartment in Islamabad for a short stay? Here's everything you need to know before booking — what "furnished" actually includes, how pricing works, which areas suit your needs, and a verification checklist.

## What "Furnished" Means on Kor Da

Every furnished apartment on Kor Da includes these **standard amenities**:

### Bedroom
- Bed with mattress, pillows, clean linens
- Wardrobe or closet with hangers
- Bedside table(s) with lamp(s)

### Living Area
- Sofa/seating for stated guest count
- Coffee table
- LED TV (usually 32-50")
- WiFi router (high-speed included)

### Kitchen (Full)
- Stove (gas or electric)
- Refrigerator
- Microwave
- Electric kettle
- Cookware: pots, pans, baking tray
- Utensils: knives, spatulas, ladles, cutlery
- Crockery: plates, bowls, glasses, mugs
- Basic spices, oil, tea, coffee (varies by host)

### Bathroom
- Geyser/water heater
- Towels (bath, hand, face)
- Toilet paper starter roll
- Basic toiletries (soap, shampoo — varies)

### Utilities & Extras (Included in Price)
- Electricity, gas, water — **no separate bills**
- High-speed WiFi
- Air conditioning (all rooms)
- UPS or generator backup (critical in Pakistan)
- Building maintenance & security

## Common Premium Add-Ons (Varies by Property)

- Washing machine (in-unit or building)
- Dishwasher
- Iron/steamer + ironing board

**Weekly discount:** 10–15% | **Monthly discount:** 20–30%

## Best Areas for Furnished Apartments

| F-10, F-11 | Modern, Margalla views, quiet | Families, extended stays |
